svg.aria-label: flowchart: a deploy pipeline with a smoke gate: preview → tests → manual approval → canary → production

g.data-node-description: Every merge to the main branch triggers the pipeline.

g.data-node-description: Compiles the application and runs the linter with type checking.

g.data-node-description: Runs unit and integration tests against an ephemeral database.

g.data-node-description: Deploys a preview and probes the critical paths before anything ships.
g.desc: Deploys a preview and probes the critical paths before anything ships.

g.data-node-description: A human reviews the preview and approves the canary rollout.
g.desc: A human reviews the preview and approves the canary rollout.

g.data-node-description: Routes a small share of traffic while error budgets are watched.
g.desc: Routes a small share of traffic while error budgets are watched.

g.data-node-description: Promotes the canary to full production traffic.
